expected_solc_divergence.reason: Before '0.8.4' solc reported error 4579 on the `new A()`, without reachability analysis. Since '0.8.4' solc leaves getters out of its reachability analysis, so it never records A's dependency on B and accepts this program, then fails with an internal error during code generation. Slang counts a public constant's getter as an entry point and reports the cycle on every version.
